faq.q: What is the Ganado Retro Build in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is a customized version of Jason's Vapid Ganado pickup, included as a Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition benefit. Rockstar describes it as Jason's well-worn, low-riding Ganado pickup with exclusive modifications.

faq.q: What modifications does the Ganado Retro Build have?
faq.a: Rockstar does not publish a complete list of the modifications. The official material only confirms that the build carries exclusive changes and a low-riding stance, without detailing each part.

faq.q: How is the Ganado Retro Build obtained?
faq.a: It is included with the Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition. Rockstar has not described any other way to acquire this specific build.

faq.q: Is the Ganado Retro Build the same as the standard Vapid Ganado?
faq.a: No. The record treats it as a distinct variant of the Vapid Ganado, Jason's pickup, rather than the base vehicle. Rockstar's official screenshot archive lists a dedicated image for the Ganado Retro Build separate from the standard Ganado.

faq.q: Can the Ganado Retro Build's exact look be recreated later in the game?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said whether the same build can be recreated through in-game customization. That remains an open question beyond what the official material confirms.

notKnown: Whether the build can be recreated through in-game customization
howWeKnow: Rockstar's official Grand Theft Auto VI editions page names the Ganado Retro Build as an Ultimate Edition benefit and describes it as Jason's modified, low-riding Vapid Ganado, with a matching image in the official screenshot archive. Both appeared on 24 June 2026 as first-party Rockstar material.
